description:
Every github-pages deployment since 2026-09-08 16:13 UTC has failed (~9 in a row across merged fixes #2088-#2091 and multiple SHAs). Each fix moved the failure later: #2089 fixed an empty artifact-id interpolation (JS parse error, pre-send); #2091 fixed a dangling commit-tree OID sent as pages_build_version (provider HTTP 404, post-send, no deployment created). The gen-6 promotion (transaction b706c659, run 34476129946, 2026-09-10) got further still: createDeployment succeeded, GitHub published the artifact, and benchbox.dev now serves the validated gen-6 candidate on all five routes (/, /docs/, /docs/api.html, /results/, /results/data/results.duckdb 434c0b10...; last-modified 12:28:50Z, cache-stable). But the deployment never reported SUCCESS/ACTIVE within the adapter's 12x5s poll, GitHub marked deployment 6371468701 "failure" at 12:29:52Z, the Execute job threw, and verify + durable-finalize were skipped.

Result: a split-brain. Provider edge serves gen-6; journal durable head is still gen 3 (legacy-import-34249636570); gen-6 tx b706c659 is recovery-required; next_generation advanced to 7; no signed live receipt was issued. GitHub's own records are also inconsistent (deployment "failure", GET /repos/.../pages status: null, gen-3 deployment 6331938635 still marked active). The remaining fault looks like GitHub Pages environment/config, not the adapter: pages.status null, source.branch "main" while build_type "workflow", custom-domain protected_domain_state null.

This blocks the independent-production-deployer-and-retirement soak (its w8) and everything downstream (A10, A11). Handoffs: /tmp/publication-handoff.md, /tmp/publication-handoff-2.md. None of #2088-#2091 have tracker items; this one covers the class.
